[h3] About Game [/h3]

2080, Japan. Neo-Yokohama is a chaotic, violent hellhole.

With the police nowhere to be seen and crime hiding itself in every corner, citizens are permitted to bear arms for self-defense. The town is well and truly a final refuge for those with nowhere else left to go.

It's in this neon town that a lone girl named Kanon lurks on the streets, ready for battle.
She's on a mission to track down and put an end to Elysion, the drug that has embedded itself deep into the dirty fabric of Neo Yokohama.
